# Real grok output

`grok-implement-pass.jsonl` and `grok-review-structured.json` are captured from
grok 1.0.62 (2026-10-18), with paths shortened and the thinking text trimmed.
The review's `text` holds two concatenated objects: the answer is only in
`structuredOutput`. `grok-review-no-structured.json` is a hand-made variant
without `structuredOutput`, for the error path.
